name: 同時に一つ選ぶセグメント切替
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Targeted correction of LH07-0025. Image1 ORIGINAL source is authority for icon geometry and fine control anatomy. Image2 is the previous generated edit target. Image3 is secondary mock for locked Japanese typography and content. Official pure-white/forest-green/slate design remains binding.
Revise ONLY the three-option control in Image2 to a much more compact, content-sized segmented control. Japanese text exactly 小さめ / 標準 / 大きめ; middle selected. Intended native UI dimensions: total 216px wide by 32px high, three equal 72px cells; locked Meiryo Regular 400, 12px/16px, tracking0 unchanged. Each label has about18px horizontal padding, not the huge empty width of the previous candidate. 1px subtle neutral outer border, 8px outer radius, selected middle cell inset2px and radius6px. Keep white background and inactive cells, slate inactive text, forest gradient selected cell with white text. No thick bevel, no heavy shadow. Compact everyday utility control, small restrained corner radius. Render a tightly framed strip with only a small amount of white clearance around the whole control. Do not stretch the control to fill the image. Preserve crisp Japanese type and all three labels. The design must visibly have much less empty space around each label than Image2. The attached original source governs the selected-state anatomy, but this new direct owner request overrides its wide354x44 dimensions. Treat requested216x32 as native intended display size; output pixels are inspection resolution only.
reviewNotes: 所有者のサイズ・余白指摘に対する第1修正。全体は縮小したが、ラベル周辺と画面外側の余白が依然広い。さらに詰める。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
